disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. HDFC is moving holders to Swiggy Ornge or Swiggy BLCK. Current card benefits continue until migrated.

joining.summary: The joining fee is ₹500 plus tax. Prefer the product page figure if a MITC OCR table shows a different number.

annual.summary: The renewal fee is ₹500 plus tax.

annual_waiver.summary: The fee is waived on ₹2 lakh of anniversary spends, excluding cash-on-call, balance transfer, and cash withdrawal.

base_earn.summary: Other categories earn 1 percent cashback, up to ₹500 per billing cycle, except fuel, rent, EMI, wallet, jewellery, and government spends. Transactions below ₹100 earn no cashback.

accelerated.summary: Swiggy app Food, Instamart, Dineout, and Genie earn 10 percent cashback, up to ₹1,500 per billing cycle. There is no cashback on Swiggy Money wallet, liquor, or Minis. Selected online categories earn 5 percent cashback, up to ₹1,500 per billing cycle, subject to the MCC list in the T&Cs.

redemption.summary: Cashback posts as statement credit for statements after 21 June 2024. Older statements used Swiggy Money on the app. The MITC ₹50 cashback-redemption fee does not apply to Swiggy.

milestones.summary: The annual fee waiver is ₹2 lakh of anniversary spend. Cashback is capped at ₹1,500, ₹1,500, and ₹500 per cycle across the 10 percent, 5 percent, and 1 percent tiers.

welcome.summary: The card includes 3 months of Swiggy One if it is activated within 30 days. Claim the offer in the Swiggy app 2 to 3 days after activation. Existing One members receive 3 extra months.
